reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: the p0030 grant runs to Licensee alone, p0045 limits access to Licensee's own employees, p0049 permits immediate termination for any breach with no materiality or cure, p0134 auto-terminates on Change of Control and p0149 bars any transfer — i.e. the walk-away combination of at-will revocability plus excluded Affiliates/contractors.

Redline reaches the preferred position: it extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf (with Licensee responsible for their compliance), confirms transfer to an M&A successor without consent and non-termination on such a transaction, and limits Licensor revocation to a material breach uncured after 30 days' notice — matching the rule's insert-affiliates / delete-revocability / add-successor-transfer guidance.

The failed 'no at-will revocation remains' check is explained by the drafting approach rather than a substantive gap: p0049/p0134 text is left in place but expressly overridden by the 'Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement' opener in the amended grant, which is a legitimate and smaller edit than rewriting four separate paragraphs; the 0.811 changed-character ratio reflects necessary additive language, not a stray rewrite.
Comment is accurate, first-person plural, cites the playbook position and offers the Affiliates-on-written-notice fallback; no misstatement of the original text.

Advisory only (not a fail): if the counterparty resists the override construct, consider companion conforming edits to Article IV (p0049), Article XX (p0134) and the assignment clause (p0149) so the surviving language does not create interpretive conflict.
